name: Drift
description: Three soft colour fields drifting behind frosted glass. Quiet, and the smallest scene to learn from.

name: Dune Drift
description: Desert ridges roll past at different speeds under a low sun, with wind-blown sand and a few birds. Two inks and one accent colour.

name: Koi Pond
description: Koi wind between drifting lily pads while ripples spread across the water, in halftone dots that swell and shrink with the movement.

name: Honu Lagoon
description: Sea turtles paddle through a bright lagoon, past coral, fish and rising bubbles, drawn as coloured ASCII tiles.

name: Night Orbit
description: A ringed planet turns while a moon circles it, stars drift in layers and the odd meteor cuts across, all in braille dots.
